comments.author: @marcus_b1
comments.text: The woman in Georgia talking about 76 degree ac is LYING. GA has a base rate. Running an ac all the time is going to add at least $50 to your bill. Also you can get 76 degrees from an open window and a fan. Also her refrigerator would push her bill beyond $50 total in general even if you DON'T include the ac or lights or tv, etc. Don't trust folks online.
